'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Steve Harpster DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration]]
